deliveryAndPayment.title: Delivery and payment
deliveryAndPayment.description: Payment methods, delivery terms across Mogilev and the region, and rules for receiving, returning and exchanging BRW furniture.
deliveryAndPayment.heading: Delivery and payment
deliveryAndPayment.lead: We deliver furniture across Mogilev and the Mogilev region. You can pay in cash on delivery or at the pickup point.

payment.heading: Payment methods

courier.title: Cash on delivery
courier.text: You pay the courier when you receive your order. Available for delivery within Mogilev.

pickup.title: Cash at the pickup point
pickup.text: You pay and collect your order at the store.

card.text: Online card payment will be available later.

payment.installmentLink: Want to pay in parts? See installment and loan terms

delivery.heading: Delivery
delivery.lead: We deliver furniture across Mogilev and the Mogilev region.

price.title: Cost
price.text: Depending on the order amount, delivery is either paid or free. The manager will tell you when confirming your order.

place.title: Where we deliver
place.text: Delivery is made to the building entrance.

warning.title: Good to know
warning.lift: The seller does not carry furniture up floors or into the apartment and is not liable for any damage caused while doing so.
warning.unload: Unloading from the vehicle is done by the buyer. Arrange helpers in advance who can unload the order.

receiving.heading: Receiving your order
receiving.lead: Furniture is handed over disassembled and packed. Check your order right when you receive it.

count.title: Check the quantity
count.text: Compare the number of packages with your order.

integrity.title: Inspect the packages
integrity.text: Make sure the packages are intact and unopened. Always check mirrors and glass items.

completeness.title: Check completeness and quality
completeness.text: Verify the contents and inspect the parts.

report.title: Report any problem
report.text: If you find damaged or opened packages, mechanical damage or missing items, tell the seller immediately.

claim.title: Defect claim
claim.text: Contact the store within 3 calendar days: describe all defects in a written claim and attach photos showing all marking labels of the package (on an electronic medium or by email to the store).
claim.assembled: Claims to remedy defects are accepted only if the furniture is disassembled. The seller is not liable for chips, cracks, scratches or other defects on furniture you have assembled.

returns.heading: Returns and exchanges
returns.title: Furniture cannot be returned or exchanged
returns.text: Furniture of proper quality is on the list of non-food goods that cannot be returned or exchanged for a similar item of a different size, shape, dimensions, style, colour or configuration. It is also exempt from the requirement to provide a similar item free of charge during repair or replacement.
returns.law: Law of the Republic of Belarus “On Consumer Rights Protection”, Council of Ministers Resolution No. 26 of 14 January 2009.

documents.heading: Documents

items.contract: Contract: order for delivery of goods from the online store

documents.completion: The order is considered fulfilled after payment, signing of the consignment note and the contract.
documents.pickupDeadline: For pickup, collect the furniture from the warehouse within 5 days of being notified that the order is ready.

price.a: It depends on the order amount. The manager will tell you whether delivery is free in your case when confirming the order.

term.q: How quickly is an order fulfilled?
term.a: The order lead time is from 2 to 30 calendar days.

lift.q: Will you carry the furniture up to my floor?
lift.a: No. Delivery is made to the building entrance. The seller does not carry furniture up floors or into the apartment. Unloading from the vehicle is done by the buyer.

damage.q: What should I do if I find damage?
damage.a: Tell the seller immediately upon receipt. Within 3 calendar days, contact the store with a claim and photos of the defects showing all marking labels of the package. Claims are accepted only for disassembled furniture.

return.q: Can I return or exchange furniture?
return.a: No. Furniture of proper quality cannot be returned or exchanged under the legislation of the Republic of Belarus.

pickup.q: How long is an order held for pickup?
pickup.a: Collect the furniture within 5 days of being notified that the order is ready.

card.q: Can I pay by card on the website?
card.a: Not yet. Card payment on the website is temporarily unavailable. Pay in cash on delivery within Mogilev or at the pickup point.

steps.1: Tell the consultant that you are arranging a loan through Belarusbank.
steps.2: To get the original invoice, visit the brand store in your city.
steps.3: Go to the bank with the invoice and the required set of documents.
steps.4: After the bank transfers the funds, you will receive an SMS with the delivery date and time.

facts.payment: In equal installments. You can repay at the bank’s info kiosks, via internet and mobile banking, or by autopay.

details.documents: Passport, invoice stating the manufacturer, proof of income (valid for up to 30 calendar days from issue).
details.citizenship: Citizens of Belarus, foreign citizens and stateless persons with a residence permit in Belarus.
details.age: From 21 to 65 years at the time of submitting documents.
details.military: They additionally provide a document confirming military service status (conscript certificate, military ID, etc.) and copies of pages with personal data and significant marks.

facts.applying: In the Prior Online mobile app.
facts.disbursement: By transferring funds to the seller’s settlement account.

bsb.name: Loan “Not just a loan, but for BELARUSIAN goods”

facts.disbursement: The bank transfers the funds directly to the showroom’s account.

delivery.question: How does delivery work?

assembly.question: Do you assemble the furniture?

warranty.question: What is the warranty?
warranty.answer: BRW furniture comes with an 18-month warranty. If a factory defect is found, we replace the part or the item.
